style: British English (colour, neighbour, grey, behaviour, flat, garden, lead). Warm and clear, not stiff; short sentences like the original.
'gazdi' = owner (say 'owner' or 'dog owner'; 'first-time owner' for 'első kutyás gazdi'). 'kutyás' as a noun = dog person / dog owner.
The app name 'Pacsi' stays 'Pacsi' (it is Hungarian for 'high five' / 'paw shake'). 'by DarwinAI' stays.
Quote marks: use curly English quotes “like this”, not Hungarian „…”.

Dog breed names: always the name from breed_names.json. For group words use: sheepdog, herding dog, guard dog, hunting dog, gundog, scenthound, sighthound, terrier, spitz, toy dog, companion dog, working dog.
Coat words: short / medium / long / wire-haired (drótszőrű) / curly / corded (zsinóros) / hairless. Sizes: toy, small, medium, large, giant.
Health items are bullets in a list: use the standard English veterinary term, capitalised first letter, no full stop; keep the brackets and abbreviations (PRA, IVDD, CEA, MDR1…).
Do not translate Latin / international disease names that are the same in English (e.g. Syringomyelia, Wobbler syndrome, Addison's disease). Hungarian 'kór' = disease, 'szindróma' = syndrome.
